subject: planner: move logical apply to logicalop pkg. (#55370)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focused on planner-only behavior. Change is a refactor moving `LogicalApply` from `pkg/planner/core` to `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop`, updating all Apply constructions/type assertions, and rewiring Apply physical-plan enumeration via `utilfuncp.ExhaustPhysicalPlans4LogicalApply` assigned in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go`. No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, transaction/session, or concurrency issues found in the touched planner paths; later `upstream/master` history shows further refactors but no follow-up indicating a remaining High/Blocker problem from this move.
